model_reading_guidance: list authorized installed documents when the exact identifier is unknown, then resolve the exact identifier, edition, and representation before relying on evidence
treat derived_structure as automated unreviewed navigation and page_text as physical extracted text
use search only for discovery, then retrieve exact evidence under an immutable package digest
preserve governing conditions, exceptions, notes, referenced tables or figures, citations, review status, and coverage
distinguish MIL-STD scope, tailoring, references, definitions, requirements, and verification methods
do not infer project applicability or compliance from normative wording alone
zero explicitly classified obligations is not proof of zero requirements when classification is incomplete

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search standards evidence
tools.description: Discover authorized records by explicit local lexical mode: exact_phrase preserves token order and adjacency, all_terms requires every parsed term, any_terms accepts at least one, and natural_language uses bounded stemming with a disclosed one-step relaxation when its strict match is empty. Results include identifier, edition_id, and package_digest for replay; they are candidates, not applicability, obligation completeness, or exact document identity; use resolve_document for an identifier and replay a selected evidence_selector through get_clause.

query.description: Search text; parsed locally and never sent to a network service.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, from 1 through 100.

package_digest.description: Optional exact authorized package SHA-256 pin.

scope_prefix.description: Optional exact clause reference or dot-delimited descendant scope.

query_mode.description: Explicit lexical interpretation; natural_language applies bounded stemming and discloses any fallback.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List installed standards
tools.description: List authorized installed document packages with exact identity, representation, immutable package digest, record count, and declared coverage. Optional normalized identifier-prefix filtering and signed pagination remain bound to the startup principal; current publisher status does not establish a project baseline.

limit.description: Maximum documents to return, from 1 through 100.

cursor.description: Optional opaque signed cursor from the preceding page.

tools.name: resolve_document
tools.title: Resolve a standard edition
tools.description: Resolve an exact authorized identifier, optional edition, and representation to an immutable package digest. Specify representation when ambiguous: derived_structure is automated and unreviewed, while page_text is physical extracted text.

identifier.description: Exact document identifier to resolve; no fuzzy identifier matching.

edition_id.description: Optional exact edition identity when more than one is installed.

representation.description: Optional exact representation; required when the identifier and edition are ambiguous.

tools.name: get_clause
tools.title: Get exact clause evidence
tools.description: Retrieve one exact package-pinned record and its required evidence context. Interpret exact text with citations, relationships, derivation review status, and coverage; this does not decide applicability or compliance.

package_digest.description: Exact authorized package SHA-256 pin returned by resolution or search.

clause_reference.description: Exact clause reference selector; supply this, record_id, or both.

record_id.description: Exact stable record selector; supply this, clause_reference, or both.

max_bytes.description: Optional positive response budget in UTF-8 bytes.

response_profile.description: Optional deterministic evidence projection; omission returns the full packet.

tools.name: build_context
tools.title: Build clause context
tools.description: Retrieve multiple exact package-pinned records with their deduplicated required context. Preserve conditions, exceptions, notes, and unresolved relationships; the packet is evidence, not an approval decision.

clause_references.description: One or more exact clause references whose required context is assembled.

max_bytes.description: Optional positive response budget in UTF-8 bytes.

response_profile.description: Optional deterministic evidence projection; omission returns the full packet.

tools.name: enumerate_obligations
tools.title: Enumerate classified obligations
tools.description: Traverse only records explicitly classified as obligations in one immutable package. Always inspect classification and source-interpretation coverage: zero classified rows is not proof of zero requirements.

scope_prefix.description: Optional exact clause reference or dot-delimited descendant scope.

limit.description: Maximum obligations to return, from 1 through 100.

cursor.description: Optional opaque signed cursor from the preceding page.

max_bytes.description: Optional positive response budget in UTF-8 bytes.

tools.name: diff_editions
tools.title: Compare standard editions
tools.description: Compare two authorized immutable packages by record identity and dependency context. Report evidence changes without inferring engineering impact, applicability, supersession, or compliance.

from_package_digest.description: Exact authorized baseline package SHA-256 pin.

to_package_digest.description: Exact authorized comparison package SHA-256 pin.

max_bytes.description: Optional positive response budget in UTF-8 bytes.

invariants: no principal or authorization selector is accepted from a tool caller
list_documents and resolve_document candidates expose only actively authorized packages
every tool is marked read-only and closed-world
successful calls use the same typed envelope as the CLI
server startup result_mode defaults to text_and_structured; structured_only omits successful-call text content while preserving structuredContent
anticipated failures are MCP error results carrying a typed JSON error envelope
the adapter creates no network listener and has no network or model fallback
get_clause accepts a clause reference, canonical record ID, or a pair that resolves to the same record
omitting response_profile preserves detailed JSON; compact_evidence_v1 and concise_evidence_v1 are opt-in
search package and scope filters are explicit and never trigger hidden fallback
search defaults to all_terms and returns the complete explicit query interpretation
search rejects inputs beyond its declared character, byte, term-count, or per-term bounds before FTS execution
search ranking is row-local and cannot be changed by unauthorized rows
search results include a source citation, exact indexed-text FTS5 snippet, and available structural heading ancestry
search declares FTS5 snippet delimiters once at packet level and omits ancestry when unavailable
search remains lexical and does not silently invoke exact document resolution
